powers.name: Touch of Law
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a willing creature. For 1 round it treats every d20 result on attacks, saves, skill checks, and ability checks as an 11. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Staff of Order
powers.summary: As a standard action, give a touched weapon the axiomatic special ability for rounds equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

powers.name: Bit of Luck
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a willing creature. During its next round it rolls each d20 twice and takes the better result. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Good Fortune
powers.summary: As an immediate action before the result is revealed, reroll one d20 roll you just made. Usable once per day at 6th level, plus once per six levels beyond 6th.

powers.name: Hand of the Acolyte
powers.summary: As a standard action, throw a held melee weapon at a target within 30 feet. Use Wisdom instead of Dexterity on the attack roll; the weapon deals normal damage and returns. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Dispelling Touch
powers.summary: As a standard action, make a melee touch attack to use a targeted dispel magic effect. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

powers.name: Wooden Fist
powers.summary: As a free action, make unarmed strikes without provoking attacks of opportunity, deal lethal damage, and add half cleric level to damage. Usable for rounds per day equal to 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Bramble Armor
powers.summary: As a free action, grow thorns that deal 1d6 piercing damage plus 1 per two cleric levels to creatures striking you with unarmed or non-reach melee attacks. Usable for rounds per day equal to cleric level.

powers.name: Resistant Touch
powers.summary: Gain a +1 resistance bonus on saving throws, increasing by +1 every five cleric levels. As a standard action, transfer this bonus to an ally for 1 minute, losing it yourself for that duration. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Aura of Protection
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Allies gain a deflection bonus to AC and energy resistance, both improving at higher levels.
